summary: To add roles to a user: Access Management > Users > user > Roles > Add roles, choose resource type, resources and roles, then Finish. Pick the right component context and consider a custom role when several are needed.

answer_card.title: Assign a role to a user
answer_card.answer_md:
1. **Access Management > Users**, select the user, open **Roles** and click **Add roles**.
2. Choose a **Resource type** (watch the component: Automation Execution vs Automation Decisions), click **Next**.
3. Select resources, then roles, review and **Finish**.
